problem: Which of the following sets is equivalent to the interval $[0,\infty )?$

feedback.problem: Which of the following intervals is equivalent to ${R}^{-}?$
feedback.worked_solution:
The set ${R}^{-}$ denotes the set of negative real numbers. It is equivalent to the following interval:

$$
(-\infty ,0)
$$

The other options are *not* equivalent to ${R}^{-}:$

- The interval $(-\infty ,\infty )$ includes the positive real numbers and zero.

- The interval $(-\infty ,0]$ includes the zero.

- The interval $(0,\infty )$ does not include the negative real numbers.

- The interval $[0,\infty )$ does not include the negative real numbers.
